question: The expression ((1-sin θ+cos θ)²(1-cos θ)sec³ θ cosec² θ)/((sec θ -tan θ)(tan θ+cot θ)) , 0° < θ < 90°, is equal to:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Substitute θ = 45° into the expression. Numerator = (1 − 1/√2 + 1/√2)² × (1 − 1/√2) × (√2)³ × (√2)² = 1 × (1 − 1/√2) × 2√2 × 2 = 4√2 − 4 Denominator = (√2 − 1) × (1 + 1) = 2(√2 − 1) = 2√2 − 2 Expression Value = (4√2 − 4) ÷ (2√2 − 2) = 2 Checking options: 2 tan 45° = 2 × 1 = 2. **∴ The correct answer is 2 tan θ.**
